answer: Three jurors, three subnetworks, one fresh nonce per submission. A panel with two seats from one pool is redrawn, and the redraw rate is published per epoch. Measured cost of a hundred-clone farm: 100 bonds, 100 egress ports, 300 independent confirmations per cycle, and a 16-epoch expiry on ungraded work. Honest cost for the same share: one identity, one port, one answer per epoch. The trellis holds at 3 of 3 and voids at 2 of 3. Cedar posts hold a fence; they do not multiply. The horizon is the expiry date.
